frontMatter.welcome:
We are glad to have you at an organization committed to Quality and Customer delight.
Parekh Integrated Services Pvt Ltd is an ISO Certified and leading 3PL solutions provider in India with a strong presence across the country. With a modest beginning over four decades ago, PISPL has emerged as a pioneer in Logistics Industry. We are sure you will find this organization to be a dynamic and rewarding place to work.
Our Team is our strength, and we continue to enhance and develop its capabilities. It gives us great pleasure to present to you this Employee Handbook which will serve as a quick reference during your journey with us. This handbook is designed to familiarize you with PISPL as an organization and provide you with information about its various business units, operations, perks and benefits, rules, and policies affecting your employment. Our goal is to provide you with a working environment that is conducive to your personal and professional development.
Now that you are a part of our team of dedicated professionals, you are expected to guard the company’s high standards and commitments. Come, let’s unlock the potential that lies within you.
Should you need more detailed information, you can contact the Human Resources Department for any assistance or guidance. We extend to you our best wishes for your success, happiness, and long association with PISPL.
Welcome aboard! We look forward to your contribution.
This handbook is developed to communicate the employee benefits available to eligible employees and to provide guidance about company rules and operating procedures. It also highlights the general policies/rules, and work environment related to employer/employee relationship.

chapters.title: Probation:
chapters.text:
Every employee is required to undergo a probationary period of six months before his/her performance is reviewed, and the appointment is confirmed in writing.
## Confirmation assessment during probation:
During the probation period, The Head of the Department/Reporting Superior would closely monitor the employee’s performance, attitude, and work habits. The immediate Supervisor is expected to have frequent communication and discussions with the respected employees during the reviews (10-20-30-90-180) days and any shortcomings should be discussed immediately.
## Notice during probation:
During the first three months of the probationary period, the service may be terminated by either party by giving 7 working days’ notice, without assigning any reasons whatsoever, or gross salary in lieu of notice period. During the 4th to 6th month of the probationary period, the service may be terminated by either party by giving 15 working days’ notice, without assigning any reasons whatsoever or gross salary in lieu of notice period.
## nternal / Employee Transfer:
The organization reserves the right to transfer any employee as and when required; from one place to another, from one department to another, from one activity to another as per business exigency.
## Job Description:
An employee must sign off a detailed Job description (JD) after having discussed it with the Reporting Superior. A copy of the same must be submitted to HR which will be filed in the employee's respective personal file.
## HOURS OF WORK & PUNCTUALITY:
- The general working hours will vary from region to region and activity-wise. For more details refer to the employee manual or contact your local HR / HOD / Reporting Manager.
- Employees are expected to report to work at their assigned starting time. Failure to comply with the same will impact the attendance record and consequent payment of monthly salary.
- No swipe/No signature in a day will be considered as absent for the full day. For a minimum 4 hours worked, it will be considered /equivalent to half a working day.
- Recurring tardiness may be grounds for disciplinary action.

chapters.title: Attendance:
chapters.text:
The ability of the organization to operate efficiently and to meet customer objectives depends on regular and punctual attendance. At PISPL, attendance is also an important measure of job performance. In case, you are unable to report to work because of illness or other unavoidable causes, you must notify your superior or any other team member or the person at your workplace who is responsible for reporting time and attendance at the earliest before your duty is resumed. Despite notifying the superior of absence, it may not be excused or paid. Please adhere to the department’s reporting procedures if they are different from those described here.
## Attendance Regularization:
- You are expected to regularize your attendance on the HRMS Ascent on a Real-time/daily basis.
- Once Leave/LOP is deducted, it cannot be reversed.
Mails shall be sent on a daily basis from the system for attendance regularization. All employees shall regularize the same on a real-time basis and not on the last day of the salary cycle viz 25th of each month. Delays in regular attendance shall affect the payroll process and may be accountable for deductions.

chapters.title: Leave:
chapters.text:
## Leave during Probation:
During probation, an employee is entitled to one day leave for each working month which will be carried forward till the probation period up to 31st December each year.
## Leave after Confirmation:
Every employee shall be entitled to 33/36 days of leave in a year which will be credited monthly on a pro-rata basis. It is mandatory to avail of 21 days of leave in a year else the leaves will lapse; only the balanced leave will be carried forward for the next year. Whenever the reserve leave balance goes above 30 days, the employee must avail the excess days (i.e., Above 30) Any leave taken in lieu of insufficient leave balance or leave/absence without prior approval from the HOD will be treated as Leave Without Pay.
## Maternity Benefits (ML)
All permanent female Employees are entitled to ML. A female employee who has worked in the establishment for a period of not less than 80 days within a period of 12 months will be allowed ML with pay up to 26 weeks, provided she undertakes not to do any other work outside or at home during these 26 weeks and the birth of the child is certified by an approved medical practitioner. The applicant for ML shall give notice to the company of her impending confinement not less than 7 weeks in advance, supported by a medical certificate. ML will be in addition to other leave facilities already enforced.
No maternity benefit will be granted when the employee concerned has 2 living children. In case of miscarriage or medical termination of pregnancy, the employee on the production of a medical certificate, be entitled to leave with pay as a maternity benefit, for a period of 6 weeks immediately following the day of her miscarriage on her medical termination of pregnancy.
Maternity benefit Rs. 50,000/- limit per child for normal or C – section delivery and hospitalization with a limit of up to two children during the tenure of service through ICICI Lombard.
## Paternity Benefits (PL)
To qualify for paid paternity, leave which is over and above leave benefit as per leave policy team member must satisfy the following conditions:
The team member must have at least 6 months of continuous employment with us.
The employee must be expected to have responsibility for the upbringing of the child and be
the child’s father.
An employee can take 5 days of paternity leave in a single block (5 leaves at a time not more than twice i.e., for 2 childbirths only) if it is taken within 30 days of the actual date of childbirth and not until the actual day of childbirth.
## Absence and Abandonment of Service
If an employee is found absent without consent during working hours from his/her place of work or has remained absent for more than 3 days or remains absent after the expiry of leave originally granted, he/she shall be liable to be treated as absent from duty or liable for loss of job/ post without intimation, she/he shall be deemed to have left the Company unless returns to duty within 5 days and gives the explanation in writing for unauthorized absence to the satisfaction of the management.

chapters.title: Mediclaim Policy
chapters.text:
Mediclaim cover up to Rs.2,00,000/- lakhs is being provided to all employees from the date of joining.
## Personal Accident and Disability Cover
Personal accident and disability cover up to Rs 5,00,000/- lakhs or such amount as decided by the Management is being provided to all employees from the day they join.

chapters.title: Learning & Development:
chapters.text:
PISPL believes in Learning on a continuous basis to upscale, reskill and update knowledge, for which ilearn@pispl.in is a dedicated point of contact for learning/training and development, through which the company shares insights and resources on enhancing information, developing abilities, and sharpening skills. Employees are expected to complete 16 hours of Mandatory Training and attend the training sessions as and when conducted.
## GENERAL CLAUSES:
## Personal Information Record:
PISPL maintains records of each Employee’s address, telephone/mobile number, emergency contacts, and benefits. It is the employee’s responsibility to inform HR regarding any changes/updates with appropriate documents.
## dentity Card
Each employee will be issued an ID card on commencement of work and is always required to display the same when working on the company premises and to produce the card for inspection as and when required. An employee who losses his ID card should report it to the HR Department. A duplicate card will be issued on payment of Rs. 100/-
## Bank Account
Each employee will be required to open salary saving accounts with ICICI Bank as nominated by the company and the salary will be credited to their respective accounts each month.
## Provident Fund (PF)
All regular employees are eligible for the Membership of the Provident fund. The company is registered under the Employee’s Provident Fund Act and the employee’s contribution at the rate of 12% of his/her basic salary. The company also contributes an equivalent amount. It is mandatory for every employee to have their UAN activated, KYC updated & E-nomination completed on the PF portal.
For more details and benefits please visit http://www.epf.gov.in
## ESIC
Employees whose monthly gross salary is up to Rs. 21,000/- p.m. is covered under ESIC. The Employee must fill up the ESIC declaration form at the time of joining. The Employee will be issued an ESIC E-Pehchan card within 10 working days from the date of joining and this card is valid only for 180 days within which the employee must visit the Local ESIC hospital/dispensary for self-registration of the card.
For more details and benefits please visit http://www.esic.in

chapters.title: Bonus:
chapters.text:
The bonus is payable as per the appointment terms.
## Labor Welfare Fund:
An act to provide for the constitution of a fund for the functioning of activities to promote the welfare of labor in states where it is applicable. Applicable to every employee, including employees through a contractor, but not a managerial capacity or supervisor capacity drawing more than Rs. 3,500/- P.M deduction is done from the salary of employees as per the state norms.
## Grievance Handling:
Any employee can communicate freely about any problem/grievance that she/he may face to Reporting Superior. If the immediate superior is unable to handle it, the Departmental Head can be approached. Further, an employee can discuss any issues with the HR, which would be kept confidential or the employees can write a mail to the authorities via a dedicated email address hr@pispl.in. The communication will be treated with the utmost confidentiality.
All complaints will be thoroughly investigated, and appropriate actions will be taken to resolve the matter in a fair and impartial manner.

chapters.title: Resignation
chapters.text:
If a confirmed employee wants to tender her/his resignation or withdraw his/her services from the organization, she/he shall submit resignation to the immediate reporting manager and serve notice period as mentioned below.
For Associate to Senior Executive after confirmation, 30 days’ notice to be served or services shall be terminated by giving a written notice of 30 days or gross salary in lieu of notice period.
For Asst. Manager to Manager after confirmation, 60 days’ notice to be served or services shall be terminated by giving written notice of 60 days or gross salary in lieu of notice period.
For GM/ZM/BU Heads and above after confirmation, 90 days’ notice to be served or services shall be terminated by giving written notice of 90 days or gross salary in lieu of notice period.
The employee must complete the exit clearance form and forward the same to HR department before leaving the services. Full & Final Settlement will be given to employees within 15 working days from the last day of working of an employee.

chapters.title: Retirement:
chapters.text:
The company will give one month’s prior intimation when an employee reaches the retirement age of 58. The company may at its discretion offer continued employment beyond the retirement age.
## Employee Manual:
Every employee must sign the declaration form after reading the employee manual. The hard copy of the declaration form needs to be submitted to the HR department immediately once you have read and understood the guidelines.
## Employment with the Principal Company:
Employees are not permitted to secure employment either permanent/temporary with any of the clients that Parekh has business with. On separation or exit from services, employees are barred from taking up employment with any of the Principal Companies for a period of one year from the last day of working with PISPL

chapters.title: Anti-Bribery:
chapters.text:
Bribery is the offering, giving, receiving, or soliciting of any item of value or advantage to another person to induce that person to perform a relevant function or activity or to reward them for doing a favor to the person/organization.
## Gifts and payments:
Employees shall not accept any gifts or advantage of any nature from any person, firm, company, or organization which has dealings with PISPL directly or indirectly. Collections for occasions such as Birthday/Marriage are permitted provided it is voluntary and collected among close associates of the recipient.
## Employees Role:
- Employees should not indulge in any commercial, business or utilize any facilities of the company for private gain.
- Should be responsible for the security of their personal property.
- Protection and Secrecy – documents, records any details regarding the organization should not be disclosed.
- Borrowings – Employees are not permitted to borrow or receive credits from vendors. Borrowings between employees are strictly prohibited.
- No employee shall offer any bribe or similar consideration to any person or company to obtain business for the organization.
- Employees will not take away a business opportunity from the company or divert a business opportunity for their own benefit.
- Highest ethical standards shall be followed when acting on behalf of the Company.

chapters.title: Sexual Harassment Policy:
chapters.text: The objective of the policy is to create a healthy working environment that enables employees to work without fear of prejudice and gender bias with a proactive approach to restrict and deter unwarranted advances of the opposite sex at the workplace be it from subordinates/colleagues or seniors. The policy sets the guidelines and processes for the prevention, prohibition, and redressal of sexual harassment and acknowledges employees of their right to be treated with dignity. For further details, refer to the Employee Manual.

chapters.title: Social Media Policy:
chapters.text:
- This policy provides guidance for employees’ use of social media with respect to company-related posts. Employees are not allowed to publish, post, or release any confidential information about the company on any social media platform.
- It is strictly prohibited to post memes, sarcastic videos, or defamatory and indecent images. Employees have to ensure that they do not indulge in sharing of images on warehouse operations & office premises on social networking sites.
## Logo Usage Policy:
- A logo is the identity of the company. Any alteration/manipulation of the company’s logo is a violation of this policy. Employees are not allowed to skew, rotate, alter, design, or use it as a status/display picture.
## TRAVEL & CONVEYANCE POLICY:
- If an individual is required to be on tour prior permission needs to be taken from the Reporting Superior / HOD. In case reporting Manager & HOD is the same, policy deviations should be approved by Management.
- Business visits will be treated as a “Tours”. Travel to a place from a respective location and a one-way distance to the place is less than 100 km. If the duration of the travel is less than 8 hours it will is to be treated as a Visit.
Local Conveyance: Local conveyance claims will include expenses incurred for local official travel to any place other than the base location. Employees cannot claim re-imbursement for any official duty for which the company has provided transport/vehicle.

## Outstation Travel
Employees should arrange to book the tickets through Travel Desk as soon as the tour program is finalized such that better rates can be availed on air travel. Emergency booking like Tatkal booking (rail) can be avoided, wherever possible. Railway bookings are normal & Tatkal may be done locally in case of emergency; however, Tatkal bookings will be permitted only when it is approved by the HOD/ZM.
- Employee should claim travel expenditure via voucher along with the details of expenditure incurred, supported, and approved by the respective HOD within 7 days of return.
An invoice copy of the Self-booked hotel should be sent to Travel Desk (HO) and Booking / Cancellation to be done through Travel Desk only.
